summaryZh: UCSD SHM 研究组的页面介绍结构健康监测与损伤预测：用原位测量评估结构状态，结合未来载荷、失效模式及不确定性预测剩余寿命。研究涵盖智能结构的SHM/DP方案与能量采集等使能技术，并介绍传感、特征提取和统计建模的通用框架。
researchQuestions: 如何依据原位测量与分析评估结构组件或系统能否完成设计功能？
如何结合监测、概率载荷与失效模式模型预测剩余使用寿命并支持风险决策？

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) laboratory in the Department of Structural Engineering at the University of California San Diego.
Our research group is primarily involved in developing novel SHM/DP solutions and SHM-enabling technologies (such as energy harvesting)
probabilistic future loading and failure mode models with relevant sources of uncertainty adequately quantified
elements of data acquisition/sensing, data mining and feature extraction from acquired data, and statistical modeling and classification of features
an assessment, based on appropriate analyses of in-situ measured data
the current ability of a structural component or system to perform its intended design function(s) successfully.
forecast remaining useful life (RUL) or similar performance-level variables
in a way that facilitates risk-informed decision-making.
